WHERE RAW MATERIALS COME FROM. A fixture pays the Brewery. The three numbers are BALANCED AGAINST EACH OTHER, not picked: a malt costs one wheat and one germ, so three of each is three malt a fixture and neither piles up uselessly. Water is doubled because three different sections want it. tools/brewery_check.gd plays ten fixtures through these exact rows and prints what is left over - if something is piling up, this row is why.
